import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="notebook")
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda x: f"{x:,.2f}")
In [3]:
df = pd.read_csv("ipl_2026_deliveries.csv")
In [4]:
df["total_runs"] = df["runs_of_bat"] + df["extras"]
df["legal_ball"] = (df["wide"].fillna(0).eq(0) & df["noballs"].fillna(0).eq(0))
df["batter_ball"] = df["legal_ball"]
df["bowler_runs_conceded"] = df["runs_of_bat"] + df["wide"] + df["noballs"]
df["bowler_wicket"] = df["wicket_type"].isin(["caught", "bowled", "lbw", "stumped"])
df["over_number"] = np.floor(df["over"]).astype(int)

df["phase_bucket"] = np.select(
    [
        df["over_number"].between(0, 5),
        df["over_number"].between(6, 14),
        df["over_number"].between(15, 19)
    ],
    ["Powerplay", "Middle Overs", "Death Overs"],
    default="Other"
)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
display(df.head())

What is the total runs composition, bat runs vs extras?¶

run_summary = pd.Series({
    "Bat Runs": df["runs_of_bat"].sum(),
    "Extras": df["extras"].sum(),

})

Which teams has a highest scoring run rate?¶

In [10]:
team_rr = df.groupby("batting_team").agg(
    runs=("total_runs","sum"),
    legal_balls=("legal_ball","sum")
)
team_rr["run_rate"] = team_rr["runs"] / team_rr["legal_balls"] * 6
team_rr = team_rr.sort_values("run_rate", ascending=False)
display(team_rr)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.barplot(data=team_rr.reset_index(), x="batting_team", y="run_rate")
plt.axhline(team_rr["run_rate"].mean(), linestyle="--", label="League average")
plt.title("Team Run Rate")
plt.legend()
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()

Who scored the most boundary runs?¶

In [18]:
boundaries = df.groupby("striker").agg(
    fours=("runs_of_bat", lambda x: (x == 4).sum()),
    sixes=("runs_of_bat", lambda x: (x == 6).sum())
)
boundaries["boundary_runs"] = boundaries["fours"]*4 + boundaries["sixes"]*6
display(boundaries.sort_values("boundary_runs", ascending=False).head(10))

).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

Is there relationship between innings scoring rate and boundary percentage?¶

In [34]:
match_innings = df.groupby(["match_id","innings"]).agg(
    runs=("total_runs","sum"),
    legal_balls=("legal_ball","sum"),
    bat_runs=("runs_of_bat","sum"),
    fours=("runs_of_bat", lambda x: (x == 4).sum()),
    sixes=("runs_of_bat", lambda x: (x == 6).sum())
).reset_index()

match_innings["run_rate"] = match_innings["runs"] / match_innings["legal_balls"] * 6
match_innings["boundary_runs"] = match_innings["fours"]*4 + match_innings["sixes"]*6
match_innings["boundary_pct"] = match_innings["boundary_runs"] / match_innings["bat_runs"] * 100

corr = np.corrcoef(
    match_innings["run_rate"],
    match_innings["boundary_pct"]
)[0, 1]

print(f"Pearson correlation between run rate and boundary %: {corr:.3f}")

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
sns.regplot(data=match_innings, x="boundary_pct", y="run_rate")
plt.title("Run Rate vs Boundary Percentage")
plt.xlabel("Boundary %")
plt.ylabel("Run Rate")
plt.show()

Pearson correlation between run rate and boundary %: 0.844
